limitations: His246Asp also impaired subunit accumulation, so loss of activity is partly confounded by folding; does not itself address AllF

evidence_type: computational, family-wide conservation survey with background control
claim_tested: Is the retained anion site, and the 100% conserved insert histidine, informative against family background?
key_finding: AllF-family conservation at the power helix: Gly339 125/125 (100.0%), Gly340 125/125 (100.0%), Thr341 122/125 (97.6%), matching the SCS alpha family at 100.0%, 100.0% and 95.1%. The SucD Arg153 equivalent (PF00549 col 3) is NOT retained: Ser 28.8% / Cys 28.0% / Thr 23.2% in AllF vs Arg 92.7% in SCS alpha. Catalytic col 102 is Gln in 91.2%, the 84th percentile of AllF-family column conservation. organism_assay_context: in silico; same 125 IPR061301 and 41 IPR005810 sequences
limitations: An evolutionary argument with no binding or activity measurement on AllF; families are InterPro-defined; 125 of 500 AllF-family hits analysed
